messages:
kevin-se: Quick sync — Orbit enterprise POC. Need confirmation on the API contract for their embedding + rerank flow. Deliverables we agreed on: 1) API contract + sample payloads, 2) staging connector + network whitelist, 3) latency SLO and fallback model. Target cutover: next Fri. Who owns the connector + CR? cc @maria @jordan

maria: I can own the connector and staging setup. Will open a PR with the connector template today. Need Orbit's staging CIDR and the service account email for the whitelist.

jordan: I can handle the API contract review. I'll add an OpenAPI schema and example payloads. Will open PR in repo soon — https://git.redwood/pocteam/orbit-api/pulls/42 (draft).

lia: Who's responsible for requesting the whitelist from infra? Oncall or infra-team? We need a ticket with the CIDR and justification.

deploy-bot: ticket INF-987 created for staging whitelist request by lia. Link: https://issues.redwood/INF-987

nora: For success criteria from SE side: - 95% of queries < 200ms (p99 < 400ms) during trial window; - 99% availability; - Example prompt set (50 prompts) and rerank accuracy baseline using their labels. I'll upload the eval set to the shared drive. :clipboard:

sam: I can run the preflight perf tests Wed morning. Need model variant list, batch size, and quantization profile. @maria can you attach the connector config + model prefs?

maria: Uploaded sample payloads to the PR and added connector TODOs. Orbit provided CIDR 18.200.12.0/24 and service account orbit-staging-sa@orbit.example.com — added to INF-987 note.

jordan: API schema PR is ready for review: https://git.redwood/pocteam/orbit-api/pull/42. Added a mock server Dockerfile snippet to help QA: ```docker run -p 8080:8080 mock-orbit:latest``` Also documented the embeddings shape and reranker scoring field `score_delta`.

kevin-se: Nice progress, thanks. Can we freeze scope by EOD Tue so SE can send the trial kickoff doc to Orbit? If yes I'll schedule the kickoff and send the test windows. :thumbsup:

maria: Scope freeze by EOD Tue works for me. I'll mark connector PR as WIP -> review-ready by then.

jordan: I'll complete API comments and address naming nits by Monday. After that we can merge the contract and tag the mock server.

kevin-se: Great — action items: - maria: connector PR + staging config (owner) - jordan: finalize API schema - lia: follow INF-987 and confirm whitelist applied - sam: perf run Wed - nora: upload eval prompts. I'll send kickoff doc once INF-987 is green.

nora: I'll upload the eval set by EOD Mon and add success criteria checklist to the kickoff doc.

sam: Adding perf test playbook to the PR comments so testers can re-run easily.

kevin-se: Thanks everyone — ping me in-thread if anything blocks scope freeze.
